00084     double autocorr (long size, double *data, double *result) {
00085         long i,j,k;
00086         double temp,norm;
00087 
00088         for (i=0;i<size/2;i++)      {
00089             result[i] = 0.0;
00090             for (j=0;j<size-i-1;j++)    {
00091                 result[i] += data[i+j] * data[j];
00092             }
00093         }
00094         temp = result[0];
00095         j = (long) size * 0.02;
00096         while (result[j]<temp && j < size/2)    {
00097             temp = result[j];
00098             j += 1;
00099         }
00100         temp = 0.0;
00101         for (i=j;i<size*0.5;i++) {
00102             if (result[i]>temp) {
00103                 j = i;
00104                 temp = result[i];
00105             }
00106         }
00107         norm = 1.0 / size;
00108         k = size/2;
00109         for (i=0;i<size/2;i++)
00110             result[i] *=  (k - i) * norm;
00111         if (result[j] == 0) j = 0;
00112         else if ((result[j] / result[0]) < 0.4) j = 0;
00113         else if (j > size/4) j = 0;
00114         return (double) j;
00115     }
